Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity planning — need staggered delivery + cloud backstop

Vanessa,

Thanks for the call earlier. To recap from our side: the product roadmap pushes a hard availability milestone in Q4 (target week of 2028-10-02) that requires ~320 A100-equivalent GPUs surfaced as dedicated capacity across two regions (us-west and us-east) with a canary slice (20 machines) live two weeks earlier.

We understand OEM lead times are stretched — we need options that let us: 1) reserve a tranche with staggered physical delivery (partial shipments across Aug–Nov), 2) receive firm OEM quotes that include partial-ship pricing and 3) have CloudBridge or another cloud partner as a short-term backstop for peak-initial months so our customers aren't delayed.

Can you provide:
- current Olympus OEM lead-time estimate and whether partial shipments are supported,
- recommended commit cadence (e.g., 25% now / 50% aug–sep / 25% oct),
- any upcharge numbers for expedited lanes and customs hold buffers, and
- a proposal for an interim cloud backstop (price and region latency expectations).

Alicia

(415) 555-0132

P.S. attaching our SOW excerpt for the milestone so you can map capacity to usage patterns.

Vanessa / team — pulling numbers together from Olympus. Summary below (short version):

- Olympus (channel rep: Diego Torres, sales@olympus-oem.com) confirms partial shipments are supported but with two constraints: 1) minimum tranche is 40 units; 2) partial shipments will be scheduled only after a 30% deposit and a confirmed manufacturing slot (manufacturing slot lead time ~14–16 weeks from slot confirmation).
- Lead time (current): 18–24 weeks for full build-to-order from slot confirmation. Partial shipment cadence they propose: 40 / 80 / remainder (we can request 3-way split, they agreed to try).
- Expedited lane: +12% on BOM cost + potential freight expedite (estimated).
- Customs/port buffer: they recommend a 2–3 week contingency per tranche if shipping internationally.
- Attachment: Olympus_OEM_quote_v2.pdf (quote v2, includes line items and expedite uplift).

Immediate recommendation:
1) Ask Acme to commit to a 25% deposit to reserve a manufacturing ladder that gives us priority sloting (this aligns with Olympus terms).
2) Reserve an interim cloud backstop (CloudBridge or similar) for weeks 1–10 post-canary. Karthik, can you price the backstop for 20 A100-equivalent instances in us-west + 10 in us-east for 60 days? Also show delta per-1000 tokens cost vs dedicated.
3) Negotiate tranche sizes down to 30 minimum for Acme if we can underwrite expedited uplift. Olympus said they can consider but require commercial justification.

I'll escalate to Olympus execs if Acme wants an earlier slot; they asked for a signed commitment (even if tranche-based) to push manufacturing queue.
